source: due2-native: a relative deadline in ISO 8601's week form (#125)
notes: The policy is valid ODRL 2.2 and passes odrl22-shape.ttl, which checks a literal's datatype but not whether its lexical form names a value; the rejection is due2's. ISO 8601 has a week form, PnW, but xsd:duration does not, so a duration regex that allows W accepts what XSD rejects. due2-mixed-duration tests a well-formed duration of two kinds. clingo-i declines the policy too, since its `DURATION` pattern (spikes/clingo-i/clingo_i/values.py) has no week part.

expected_rejection.why: ex:pay's dprod:deadline "P1W"^^xsd:duration names no xsd:duration, whose parts are years, months, days, hours, minutes, and seconds (XSD 1.1 Part 2 §3.3.6). A relative deadline is an xsd:duration (due2-profiles.md §7), so W1 rejects the policy in stage 2.
